hook: Your map of Bolivia shows two capitals.
title: Bolivia Has Two Capitals
description:
Bolivia's constitutional capital is Sucre, and the courts sit there. La Paz is where the president and congress work. So both cities have a real claim to being the capital.

#Shorts #Bolivia #Geography
